CONFIDENCE: 0.33
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows the characteristic sulfone / sulfonate pattern: a very strong νs(S=O) band at 1053 cm⁻¹ and a medium-strong νas(S=O) band in the 1300–1350 cm⁻¹ region (here 1279 cm⁻¹), together with S–O / O–S–C deformation modes at 535 cm⁻¹ and 582–615 cm⁻¹. Aliphatic C–H stretches (2930, 2971 cm⁻¹) and CH₂/CH₃ bends (1450, 1378 cm⁻¹) match a straight-chain alkyl ester. Only candidate 10 (CCCCCS(=O)(=O)OCC) contains an SO₂-OR group and no carbonyl band near 1700 cm⁻¹, consistent with the absence of a C=O peak in the experimental Raman spectrum.
